proposals.evidence: DEDR 3693 directly gives Tamil/Malayalam nīṟu, Telugu nivuṟu/niguṟu, Parji nīd and Gondi nīr ‘ashes’. The ash gloss differentiates these from nīr ‘water’ (3690); multiword ash compounds are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

These simple stems and adjectival inflections are selected; new-person nouns and loan-looking alternative stems remain unassigned.
